description: This file defines a NotesService module that provides CRUD operations for notes, including validation and normalization functions, and interacts with a Notes model.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with validated and normalized data, defaulting user_id to 1 if not provided.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes based on query parameters with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note with provided data after validation.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
